+So the reduction is now machine-checked, and of the two items the residue of the open
+leaf used to consist of, **the first is now proved**:
+
+1. ~~`residueDeg k̄ P = 1`~~ — **discharged** in `Adelic/GlobalGeneration.lean` §5–§7.

+   hypotheses in adelic shape: an `Algebra k̄ K(C)` with `IsConstantField k̄ C.left`
